carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from a high-intensity upper edge to a low-intensity shadowed lower edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent white, high-luminance elongated object (tracking tag) is attached to the superior margin of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Several small, low-luminance elongated silhouettes (ectoparasites or remoras) are visible clustered near the ventral margin and trailing the primary dorsal fin.
